text: 下周港股财报密集披露，阿里巴巴(09988.HK)、泡泡玛特(09992.HK)、百度(09888.HK)、小米集团(01810.HK)、香港交易所(00388.HK)、中国石油化工股份(00386.HK)等重要个股将于下周公布财报。经济数据方面，中国至8月20日一年期贷款市场报价利率、美国8月标普全球服务业PMI初值等数据将于下周公布。此外，美联储将于下周公布货币政策会议纪要，恒指公司将公布二季度检讨结果。完整个股财报日历请前往美港电讯APP—日历查看。点击查看...
text_en: Dense earnings reports from Hong Kong stocks are due next week, with Alibaba (09988.HK), Pop Mart (09992.HK), Baidu (09888.HK), Xiaomi Group (01810.HK), Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (00388.HK), and China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation (00386.HK) among key stocks scheduled to release results. On the economic data front, China's one-year loan prime rate as of August 20 and the U.S. S&P Global services PMI flash for August are due next week. In addition, the Federal Reserve will release minutes from its monetary policy meeting next week, and Hang Seng Indexes Company will announce its second-quarter review results.
